{{Quote|According to my information tapes, Mimban doesn't have a repair station, Leia. In fact, Mimban might not even have an emergency standby station.|Luke Skywalker|<ref name="SotME">''[[Splinter of the Mind's Eye]]''</ref>}}
An '''emergency standby station''' was a very basic facility that was capable of emergency repair and other simple necessities. In a populous system it could be reasonably expected that any world with a breathable atmosphere would be equipped with such a basic facility.<ref name="SotME" />
